name: evaluate-sessions
message: [cron:evaluate-sessions] Check .state/sessions/ for unevaluated sessions (no matching .state/evaluations/ file). Skip sessions without session.jsonl (aborted). Skip currently running sessions. Delegate each to evaluator.

name: analyze-failures
message: [cron:analyze-failures] Delegate to bob: analyze the last 10 evaluations in .state/evaluations/, identify the top recurring pattern, write findings to agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md. Also compare the last 5 evaluations against the 5 before the most recent knowledge file change (check git log in agents/ for the last commit). Did the targeted agent's scores improve? If the same issue persists after a fix, say so explicitly and recommend a different approach.
description: Bob analyzes evaluation patterns every 8 hours, including fix-effectiveness

name: optimize
message: [cron:optimize] Read agents/bob/workspace/analysis.md, agents/coach/workspace/journal.md, and agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. Work on the top TODO item or the top finding. Also check for LLM-to-JS replacement opportunities in recent sessions. One fix per run.
description: Optimizer implements one fix per day from bob's analysis and coach's findings

name: health-check
message: [cron:health-check] Run: npx tsc --noEmit && npx vitest --run. Report pass/fail and test count. If anything fails, investigate.
description: Daily tsc + test suite health check

name: coaching
message: [cron:coaching] Check agents/coach/workspace/todo.md for pending training tasks (items under # TODO, not # Tracking). If any exist, delegate to coach to work on the next one. Also check agent scores via .state/evaluations/ — if any agent has 3+ sessions below threshold (eff < 0.5 or qual < 0.5), delegate to coach to run exercises on that agent.
description: Coach drains todo.md every 48h and trains underperforming agents

name: lesson-consolidation
message: [cron:lesson-consolidation] Delegate to bob: read all agents/*/knowledge/lessons.md files. Deduplicate, consolidate, remove stale entries. Preserve proven lessons.

name: system-status
message: [cron:system-status] Operational check. Run: 1) session count last 24h 2) unevaluated session backlog 3) stuck/running sessions 4) lessons.md line counts 5) bob analysis freshness 6) tsc --noEmit. Append summary to agents/may/workspace/health-log.md. If any anomalies found, add them as TODO items in agents/may/workspace/todo.md.
description: Operational status check every 4 hours — writes findings to health-log.md

name: drain-todo
message: [cron:drain-todo] Check agents/may/workspace/todo.md for pending items under # TODO. Work on the top item — delegate, fix, or resolve it. Move completed items to # Tracking with result (✅/⚠️/❌). Stop after one item.
description: Drain one TODO item every 4 hours

name: optimizer-drain-todo
message: [cron:optimizer-drain-todo] Read agents/optimizer/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under # TODO, delegate to optimizer to work on the top item. One item per run.
description: Optimizer drains its todo.md every 8 hours

name: review-human-inputs
message: [cron:review-human-inputs] Read agents/may/workspace/human-inputs.md. Extract patterns: recurring preferences, design directions, corrections, unaddressed ideas. Update todo.md with actionable findings. Clear processed entries from human-inputs.md.
description: Review human input patterns every 12 hours

name: bob-drain-todo
message: [cron:bob-drain-todo] Read agents/bob/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under # TODO (especially ## Research Tasks), delegate to bob to work on the top item. Bob should delegate to scout for fetching/research, then synthesize and evaluate himself. One item per run.
description: Bob drains his research/todo backlog every 8 hours

name: philosophy-check
message: [cron:philosophy-check] Delegate to bob: check recent git commits (git log --since='24 hours ago' --oneline) for philosophy violations. Read agents/shared/philosophy.md, then review what changed. If you find drift, either recommend a fix or update the philosophy. Write findings to agents/bob/workspace/philosophy-check.md.
description: Daily philosophy alignment check — Bob reviews commits against design principles

name: scout-explore
message: [cron:scout-explore] Delegate to scout: Run an exploration cycle. Pick 1-2 sources (rotate between GitHub trending, arXiv, Reddit Arctic Shift, vendor blogs). Search for recent activity on AI agents, autonomous systems, context engineering. Grep discoveries.md for dedup before adding. Archive findings. Follow interesting threads. Commit at 60% budget.
description: Scout explores the internet for AI agent research every 8 hours

name: amy-explore
message: [cron:amy-explore] Delegate to amy: Run an XHS exploration cycle. Search 1-2 keywords from your tracked list. Read interesting posts deeply (with xsec_token from search results). Archive findings in knowledge/. If tools fail (CAPTCHA, rate limit), synthesize from existing archive. Max 3 searches, 5+ seconds between operations.
description: Amy explores Xiaohongshu for AI content every 8 hours

name: amy-drain-todo
message: [cron:amy-drain-todo] Read agents/amy/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under ## Pending, delegate the top one to amy. When done, move the item from ## Pending to ## Completed with result (✅/⚠️/❌) and date. Stop after one item.
description: Amy drains her todo.md every 8 hours — one item per cycle

name: scout-drain-todo
message: [cron:scout-drain-todo] Read agents/scout/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under ## Pending, delegate the top one to scout. When done, move the item from ## Pending to ## Completed with result (✅/⚠️/❌) and date. Stop after one item.
description: Scout drains his todo.md every 8 hours — one item per cycle

name: amy-kimi-drain-todo
message: [cron:amy-kimi-drain-todo] Read agents/amy-kimi/workspace/todo.md. If there are pending items under ## Pending, delegate the top one to amy-kimi. When done, move the item from ## Pending to ## Completed with result (✅/⚠️/❌) and date. Stop after one item.
description: Amy-Kimi drains her todo.md every 8 hours — one item per cycle
